description: React component for rendering and interacting with a roadmap visualization, including handling node details, user interactions, and progress updates.

classes.name: RoadmapNodeDetails
classes.description: Type defining details of a roadmap node, including node ID, type, associated SVG element, and optional title.

methods.name: getNodeDetails
methods.description: Extracts node details from an SVG element by traversing its closest 'g' element and reading dataset attributes.

methods.name: updateTopicStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the progress status of a topic and refreshes related UI and data.
